research_question: How does prompting and evaluation terminology change across a versioned inventory of LLM research papers?
inclusion_criteria: Include prompting methods, model or benchmark names, evaluation metrics and experimental-setting expressions relevant to the declared literature study.
Preserve operational senses of zero-shot, few-shot and related terms rather than merging solely by spelling.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude irrelevant bibliographic names and generic prose.
Do not infer numerical result tuples, benchmark trends or new benchmark instances from terminology alone.

term_category.description: Suggested method, model, benchmark, metric or experimental_setting category.

operational_definition.description: Suggested local operational meaning, supported by a source quotation where available.

specialist_lenses.lens: Attend to method names, acronyms, benchmarks and experiment terminology.
Attend to different operational meanings of familiar experimental-setting expressions.
